name: The Crate for Mr. S— facts
notes: mw-e39.21: facts written and read by quest-crate-for-mr-s. crate.intercepted and tern.sailed are registered by main-quest; the dialogue stand-ins (evidence.*, quell.*, cray.*) are reused as they are.

facts.description: How Vane's crate was taken (bible 6.1 quest 6): heist (ballast swap and re-seal), paper (Cray's lawful seizure), net (archer cut), force (knight brawl), ice (freeze the pool or Gust the hoist), leverage (Quell), or sailed (the Tern left first). Written by quest-crate-for-mr-s.
The ballast swap and re-seal were done with no alarm raised: nobody ever knows (bible 6.1 quest 6, perfect execution). Written by the Crate for Mr. S— heist resolution.
The night watchman or the harbour watch raised the alarm at bay nine. Written by the bay nine level (stealth, E09) and by the force resolution; blocks the undetected heist resolution.
The player has Vane's honest manifest of bay nine (Vane evidence). Written by every Crate for Mr. S— resolution that takes the crate.
The player has the Hornfolk name-stone from Vane's crate (befriend-Horn trigger, bible 4.3). Written by the Crate for Mr. S— resolutions; read by horn-warden alongside horn.name-stone-held.
The Low Tide Company's standing towards the player: hostile after a dockside brawl at bay nine (bible 3.4). Written by the force resolution of the Crate for Mr. S—.
Inspector Cray arrives at the end of the bay nine brawl and will question the player (the force branch of the Crate for Mr. S—). Read by cray-customs and the Wendmouth scene (follow-up).
The Gilded Tern will sail with rocks in Vane's crate, because the heist swapped them in (bible 6.1 quest 6). Read by the Wendmouth scene and the epilogue (post-MVP hook).
The Tern sailed before the crate was taken, so only the customs house copy of the manifest remains to be had (note-cargo-manifest). Written by the sailed resolution of the Crate for Mr. S—.
